t: This is the former Finsbury Park Empire Theatre, once both a theatre and a cinema. It was designed by Frank Matcham, an English architect who specialised in theatres and music halls. Over his forty-year career he designed more than ninety theatres and refurbished roughly eighty more across the United Kingdom. Much of his London work was for Moss Empires, and the name Empire here fits that world. His other London buildings include the Hackney Empire, the Shepherd's Bush Empire, the Coliseum and the Palladium.
